a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the 8-cell plan almost certainly kills us both, because round 1 will probably be the last. The reserve holds only 4, so at most one of us can survive round 1. I intend to take 4 in round 1. I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If you'd rather propose something else, say so.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I'm taking 4 this round. If no storm comes, I'll operate every round after this so the generator runs and you can build up your 4. I won't take any more cells.
